text: Earlier work: baseline constant steps R=2/3, Gaussian 0.7071; objective maximize R=L2/Linf of f*f (exact via np.convolve). Local nonparametric L-BFGS-B on exact R from Gaussian init gave p0005=0.820996 (sparse, 64% zeros). Generalized Gaussian scan p0007=0.721258 confirmed p≈2 best in that family. Stochastic multiscale block search around a dense N=50 shape was the strongest early line: p0006=0.833314, p0002=0.818329, p0004=0.780783. Failed: p0003 low-dim symmetric control-point evolution collapsed to 0.376243 (too restrictive/badly scaled). Gen 2 refinement: p0011 (L-BFGS-B on log-heights from p0006, N up to 400) reached 0.834950 (+0.0016); p0013=0.833411; p0009 (sparse-support editing from p0005)=0.824172; other mutations barely moved. Conclusion: dense p0006 basin near local optimum, refinement gains ~0.001-0.003; sparse branch tops ~0.824, clearly below dense. Best line: p0006 dense N=50 asymmetric smooth profile (max/mean ~2.5, f*f peak ~0.75 of support), 0.834950 via p0011. Gen 3: p0018 exact analytic subgradient replacing finite differences reached 0.855700 (+0.02075, N=200, max/mean 3.30); p0017 logsumexp smooth-max homotopy (beta annealed 20→5000) was the breakthrough at 0.879272 (+0.044322, N=50, max/mean 6.77, very flat f*f top: 42.57% of knots within 0.1% of max, max at 0.740); p0019 adaptive step splitting/merging only 0.835108; mutations p0015=0.837891, p0014=0.833522, p0016=0.835109. Gen 4: p0020 analytic-gradient logsumexp at higher beta/N matched p0017 exactly (0.879272, no gain); p0025 p-norm max homotopy (p=4..256) also 0.879272, no gain; p0022 exact-R subgradient polish of the smooth solution FAILED with a broadcasting ValueError in R_and_grad (shape mismatch 51 vs 100), so smoothing-bias removal remains untested; mutations p0021 (finer grid N up to 800 + homotopy)=0.879272, p0023=0.835393, p0024=0.833543. Gen 6: p0029=0.88088 best but used only 2.68 s of 30 s; p0031=0.88055 explores the power-law branch where the continuous t^-1/2 shape has R≈0.888, suggesting a discretization gap (midpoint sampling of the singularity inaccurate). p0037 (exact 8-point step averages of t^-α(1-t)^-β, widened β, exact polish at N=2000/4000) gave 0.880551, no gain over p0031. p0034 (two-component power-law seed, scanning c and singularity position) also 0.880551, no gain — multiple singularities did not flatten f*f further. p0035 (extending exact-R subgradient polish from p0029 to N=400/800/1600 with perturbation restarts, using leftover budget) gave 0.881128 (+0.000247), the current best: N=800, max/mean 11.83, f*f max at 0.446, 45.03% of knots within 0.1% of max. Mutations p0032 (higher beta/p homotopy to 1e8/8192, N=3200)=0.879272, p0033 (upsample to 1200 + analytic homotopy + restarts)=0.879272, p0036 (analytic gradient + sharper homotopy)=0.879342 — all no gain. Open questions: whether a fundamentally different (non-local, asymmetric, or support-edited dense) structure can exceed ~0.881; whether exact-gradient high-beta continuation or different smooth-max shapes can pass the ~0.879 plateau (tried, no gain); whether the smoothing bias in the logsumexp solution can be removed by exact-R polish (attempt failed on a bug, still untested); whether sparse and dense regimes can be combined; whether the power-law branch can approach its continuous R≈0.888 limit (exact step averages and two-singularity seeds gave no gain, so the gap may be elsewhere); true optimum shape and R unknown.
